summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Gestor de MC (Career Mode Manager) completed. Successfully tested save creation wizard, dashboard functionality, squad management, calendar operations, match registration, office events, museum features, and navigation. All core features working correctly with minor localStorage persistence issue noted.
